review_method: All six current design/S01-S06/concept.png files were opened and inspected individually at original resolution. Frozen brief, deck, source, reference study, style contract, prompts, per-page generation records, and contract normalization record were reviewed.

open_findings.finding: The headline says “交付物可追溯”, but the page shows blank templates and a conceptual cover without sample identifiers, versions, locations, or links that demonstrate traceability. Its body and footer correctly say these are conceptual examples, so this is a limited wording-to-visual mismatch rather than a claim of real evidence.
open_findings.recommendation: Either soften the headline to describe deliverable types, or add clearly fictional IDs/version labels to show how traceability would work.

resolved_findings.original_finding: The original reference-input-snapshot.json described proposal S01 and case339 as “passed to image_gen”, while all six actual tool-call records declared no attached reference images.
resolved_findings.verification: The corrected snapshot says the references were viewed and their principles used in prompts, not attached. The original snapshot and freeze-record remain unchanged. The correction note states the six actual calls attached no reference images. The four frozen input hashes, six concepts, prompts, and generation records remain unchanged.

review_notes.story_and_data: The 12-week plan versus 14-week fictional closeout, stated delay reason, six rain records (five complete and one missing), two substrates with three repeats each (six bench trials), and budget arithmetic (1200+800+500=2500; 1180+760+420=2360; balance 140) agree across the scenario, source notes, deck, prompts, and viewed images.
review_notes.fictional_labels: Example/non-measured labels sit near the counts; S04 identifies blank templates and conceptual report material; S05 marks resource figures as simulated and not real receipts; S06 marks the case as fictional and future suggestions as unapproved. No real measurements, effect claims, seals, certifications, or approvals appear.
review_notes.visual_review: The six pages use distinct structures with a coherent natural palette. Main titles, counts, timeline, arithmetic, and key qualifiers were legible at original size; no material clipping or unsupported result graphic was seen.
review_notes.hash_integrity: For each page, the current project concept, design copy, generation-record output hash, and retained image-generation original hash match; the generation-record hashes also match the concept-generation log.
review_notes.contract_history: The current brief uses quality_profile draft. contract-normalization.json preserves the pre-generation frozen hashes and the later enum normalization; generation history remains bound to the earlier input hashes, while this review binds to the current four-file hashes above.
review_notes.scope_limit: This review covers the concept-only handoff. It does not claim PPTX assembly, formal competition verification, or user visual acceptance.
